High School Diploma High school diploma or equivalent, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant irrigation experience.
Irrigation Work Six years of irrigation experience in a commercial maintenance environment is preferred

Join UCLA’s Grounds team and help maintain the irrigation systems that keep our campus landscapes thriving. In this hands-on role, you’ll install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair manual and automatic irrigation systems while supporting a safe, efficient, and well-maintained campus environment. We’re looking for a skilled, safety-minded professional who takes pride in quality work and enjoys working outdoors as part of a dedicated team.
Cal/OSHA Cal/OSHA Competent Person Training

Working knowledge of the tools, materials, equipment, and procedures related to installation and repair of all manual and automatic irrigation systems, as well as knowledge of water management principles and water conservation practices.
Ability to maintain, repair, install and/or alter various types of irrigations systems.
Ability to read, interpret and understand technical language in landscape irrigation specifications and plans.
Ability to properly and safely operate related hand and power tools as well as power driven equipment such as trencher, skip loader.
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with peers, subordinates, supervisors, administrators, customers, visitors and outside agencies.
Oral communication skills to obtain or convey clear, concise and grammatically correct information.
Ability to write standard English text using correct grammar and spelling to complete reports, forms and work orders that are accurate and easy to comprehend.

Ability to use computers, mobile devices, and CMMS applications to receive and complete digital work orders, document work performed, update job status, and maintain accurate electronic maintenance records.
Skill in performing mathematical calculations to determine square footage and linear footage for trenching and new or retrofit irrigation pipe installations.
Working knowledge of standard safe work practices.
Ability to work independently and follow through on assignments.
Ability to respond to off-hour emergencies and overtime as required. Ability to work weekends as needed.
